arXiv:2603.28532v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 3 月 30 日arXiv:2603.28532v1 [cs.LG] 30 Mar 2026

使用可解释且可扩展的预测驱动框架从心电图检测低左心室射血分数Detecting low left ventricular ejection fraction from ECG using an interpretable and scalable predictor-driven framework

Ya Zhou Department of Information Center, Fuwai Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Beijing, China Tianxiang Hao The Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University, Shenzhen, China Ziyi Cai Institute of Statistics and Big Data, Renmin University of China, Beijing, China Haojie Zhu Cardiac Arrhythmia Center, Fuwai Hospital, National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Beijing, China Hejun He Institute of Statistics and Big Data, Renmin University of China, Beijing, China Jia Liu Department of Information Center, Fuwai Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Beijing, China Xiaohan Fan Cardiac Arrhythmia Center, Fuwai Hospital, National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Beijing, China Function Test Center, Fuwai Hospital, National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Beijing, China Jing Yuan Department of Information Center, Fuwai Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Beijing, China
摘要Abstract

低左心室射血分数 (LEF) 通常在进展为有症状的心力衰竭之前未被发现，这强调了可扩展筛查策略的必要性。尽管人工智能心电图 (AI-ECG) 已显示出希望，但现有方法仅依赖于可解释性有限的端到端黑盒模型，或依赖于性能次优的商业心电图测量算法的表格系统。我们引入了基于心电图的预测器驱动的 LEF (ECGPD-LEF)，这是一个结构化框架，它将基础模型派生的诊断概率与可解释的模型集成在一起，用于从心电图检测 LEF。在包含 72,475 个心电图-超声心动图对的基准 EchoNext 数据集上进行训练，并在预定义的独立内部 (n=5,442) 和外部 (n=16,017) 队列中进行评估，我们的框架实现了对中度 LEF 的稳健区分（内部 AUROC 88.4%，F1 64.5%；外部 AUROC 86.8%，F1 53.6%），始终优于官方数据提供端到端基线以及跨人口和临床亚组的基准。可解释性分析确定了高影响力的预测因素，包括正常心电图、不完全左束支传导阻滞和前外侧导联的心内膜下损伤，从而推动 LEF 风险评估。值得注意的是，这些预测因子独立地实现了零样本推理，无需特定任务的再训练（内部 AUROC 75.3-81.0%；外部 AUROC 71.6-78.6%），表明心室功能障碍本质上是在结构化诊断概率表示中编码的。该框架将预测性能与机械透明度相协调，通过额外的预测器以及与现有 AI-ECG 系统的无缝集成来支持可扩展的增强。Low left ventricular ejection fraction (LEF) frequently remains undetected until progression to symptomatic heart failure, underscoring the need for scalable screening strategies. Although artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography (AI-ECG) has shown promise, existing approaches rely solely on end-to-end black-box models with limited interpretability or on tabular systems dependent on commercial ECG measurement algorithms with suboptimal performance. We introduced ECG-based Predictor-Driven LEF (ECGPD-LEF), a structured framework that integrates foundation model-derived diagnostic probabilities with interpretable modeling for detecting LEF from ECG. Trained on the benchmark EchoNext dataset comprising 72,475 ECG-echocardiogram pairs and evaluated in predefined independent internal (n=5,442) and external (n=16,017) cohorts, our framework achieved robust discrimination for moderate LEF (internal AUROC 88.4%, F1 64.5%; external AUROC 86.8%, F1 53.6%), consistently outperforming the official end-to-end baseline provided with the benchmark across demographic and clinical subgroups. Interpretability analyses identified high-impact predictors, including normal ECG, incomplete left bundle branch block, and subendocardial injury in anterolateral leads, driving LEF risk estimation. Notably, these predictors independently enabled zero-shot-like inference without task-specific retraining (internal AUROC 75.3-81.0%; external AUROC 71.6-78.6%), indicating that ventricular dysfunction is intrinsically encoded within structured diagnostic probability representations. This framework reconciles predictive performance with mechanistic transparency, supporting scalable enhancement through additional predictors and seamless integration with existing AI-ECG systems.

**脚注文本：footnotetext:邮箱：袁静 (yuanjing@fuwai.com)、范晓涵 (fanxiaohan@fuwaihospital.org)、周娅 (zhouya@fuwai.com)Email: Jing Yuan (yuanjing@fuwai.com), Xiaohan Fan (fanxiaohan@fuwaihospital.org), Ya Zhou (zhouya@fuwai.com)

1 简介Introduction

心力衰竭 (HF) 是全球主要的健康负担，影响着全球超过 6400 万人，且患病率持续上升Heart failure (HF) is a major global health burden, affecting over 64 million individuals worldwide, with prevalence continuing to rise(Savarese et al., 2022)。在许多患者中，左心室收缩功能障碍 (LVSD) 最初是无症状的，但经常进展为有症状的心力衰竭，如果未及时发现，则预后不良。左心室射血分数（LEF）低是反映 LVSD 向临床明显 HF 进展的关键指标. In many patients, left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD) is initially asymptomatic, yet it frequently progresses to symptomatic HF and is associated with poor prognosis if left undetected. Low left ventricular ejection fraction (LEF) is a critical indicator that reflects the progression of LVSD toward clinically manifest HF(Heidenreich et al., 2022)。早期发现 LVSD 至关重要，因为及时启动循证治疗可以减轻症状、减缓疾病进展并提高生存率。尽管心血管成像，特别是超声心动图 (ECHO)，仍然是评估心室功能的临床金标准，但它需要大量时间和资源，需要专门的操作员和设备，并且不易扩展到人群水平筛查. Early detection of LVSD is critical, as timely initiation of evidence-based therapies can mitigate symptoms, slow disease progression, and improve survival. Although cardiovascular imaging, particularly echocardiography (ECHO), remains the clinical gold standard for assessing ventricular function, it is time- and resource-intensive, requires specialized operators and equipment, and is not readily scalable for population-level screening(Ciampi and Villari, 2007)。这些局限性凸显了需要具有成本效益、可广泛使用的方法来可靠地识别 LEF 患者. These limitations underscore the need for cost-effective, widely accessible approaches capable of reliably identifying patients with LEF(Attia et al., 2019; Yao et al., 2021; Tran et al., 2025; Lakshmanan and Mbanze, 2023).

心电图 (ECG) 可记录心脏电活动，是大规模筛查的一种很有前景的工具Electrocardiography (ECG), which records cardiac electrical activity, is a promising tool for large-scale screening(Hughes et al., 2024)。自威廉·埃因托芬 (Willem Einthoven) 提出并获得 1924 年诺贝尔奖以来，心电图科学稳步发展：采集变得更加容易，信号质量得到改善，并且定义了各种心律和传导障碍的病理特征. Since its introduction by Willem Einthoven, which earned him the Nobel Prize in 1924, ECG science has steadily advanced: acquisition has become easier, signal quality has improved, and pathognomonic features for a wide range of rhythm and conduction disorders have been defined(Khera, 2024)。最近，人工智能 (AI) 改变了心电图分析，使模型能够在传统解读任务中实现心脏病专家级别的表现. More recently, artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed ECG analysis, enabling models to achieve cardiologist-level performance in traditional interpretation tasks(Hannun et al., 2019; Ribeiro et al., 2020; Jiang et al., 2024; Li et al., 2025)并检测与主动脉瓣狭窄等疾病相关的微妙模式and to detect subtle patterns associated with conditions such as aortic stenosis(Kwon et al., 2020), 三尖瓣关闭不全, tricuspid regurgitation(Diao et al., 2025)，和左EF, and LEF(Attia et al., 2019)，这些往往是人类无法察觉的。尽管取得了这些进步，但临床应用情况有所不同：AI-ECG 模型被广泛接受用于心房颤动和窦性心动过缓等既定疾病，这些疾病可以根据指南进行目视确认, which are often imperceptible to humans. Despite these advances, clinical adoption varies: AI-ECG models are widely accepted for well-established conditions such as atrial fibrillation and sinus bradycardia, which can be visually confirmed according to guidelines(Joglar et al., 2024; Kusumoto et al., 2019)，但由于对可解释性的担忧以及将预测与可识别的心电图特征联系起来的困难，对于 LEF 检测等新兴任务仍然受到限制, but remain limited for emerging tasks such as LEF detection due to concerns about interpretability and the difficulty of linking predictions to recognizable ECG features(Van De Leur et al., 2022; Hughes et al., 2024)。为了增强可解释性并促进更广泛的临床部署，最近的一项研究提出了一种基于商业算法的基于 555 个离散心电图测量的随机森林模型，与 N 端激素原脑钠尿肽 (NT-proBNP) 相比，该模型在 LEF 检测方面表现出优越的性能. To enhance interpretability and facilitate broader clinical deployment, a recent study proposed a random forest model based on 555 discrete ECG measurements based on commercial algorithms, which demonstrated superior performance compared with N-terminal prohormone brain natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) for LEF detection(Hughes et al., 2024)。尽管这种方法显示出了可喜的结果，但其性能略低于深度学习。此外，正如原始研究中所强调的，在不同的心电图机上应用时无法获得许多特征，并且设备之间的测量值存在显着差异. Although this approach showed promising results, its performance is slightly below deep learning. Moreover, as highlighted in the original study, many features cannot be obtained when applied across different ECG machines, and measurement values differ markedly between devices(Strodthoff et al., 2023)，这对更广泛的临床应用构成了重大障碍。, which presents a significant barrier to broader clinical adoption.

在本研究中，我们旨在评估使用标准 12 导联心电图检测 LEF 的可解释方法的有效性。我们提出了基于心电图的预测器驱动的 LEF (ECGPD-LEF)，该框架将传统的 AI-ECG 解释模型与单预测器方法或多预测器方法集成，以增强对微妙心电图特征的识别并改进 LEF 检测。单预测器方法执行类似零样本的推理，不需要对目标数据集进行额外的训练。多预测方法是在公开的 ECG-ECHO 配对数据集 EchoNext 上进行训练的，这是一个涵盖跨种族和临床背景的不同人群的综合数据集。我们还基于 MIMIC-IV 构建了外部验证数据集 MIMIC-LEFIn this study, we aim to evaluate the efficacy of interpretable methods for detecting LEF using standard 12-lead ECGs. We propose ECG-based Predictor-Driven LEF (ECGPD-LEF), a framework that integrates traditional AI-ECG interpretation models with either a single-predictor approach or a multi-predictor approach to enhance recognition of subtle ECG features and improve LEF detection. The single-predictor approach performs zero-shot-like inference, requiring no additional training on the target dataset. The multi-predictor approach was trained on the publicly available ECG-ECHO paired dataset EchoNext, a comprehensive dataset encompassing diverse populations across races and clinical contexts. We also constructed an external validation dataset, MIMIC-LEF, based on MIMIC-IV(Johnson et al., 2024), MIMIC-IV-心电图, MIMIC-IV-ECG(Gow et al., 2023)和 MIMIC-IV-注, and MIMIC-IV-Note(Johnson et al., 2023b)，同样涵盖了异质人群。该模型在多中心数据集上进行了评估，包括内部验证（EchoNext 测试集）和外部验证（MIMIC-LEF）。该模型的性能在多个维度进行评估，包括是否存在其他结构性心脏病（SHD）和瓣膜性心脏病（VHD），以及不同的护理环境和种族或民族亚组。进行全局和局部模型解释是为了识别有助于 LEF 检测的重要预测因子，并表征与 LEF 相关的这些微妙的心电图变化。, which similarly covers a heterogeneous population. The model was evaluated on multi-center datasets, including internal validation (the EchoNext test set) and external validation (MIMIC-LEF). The model performance was assessed across multiple dimensions, including the presence or absence of other structural heart disease (SHD) and valvular heart disease (VHD), as well as across different care settings and racial or ethnic subgroups. Global and local model explanations were performed to identify important predictors contributing to LEF detection, and to characterize these subtle ECG changes associated with LEF.

2 方法Methods

2.1 数据来源Data sources

研究设计的概述如图所示An overview of the study design is provided in Figure1，说明了数据源、预测器提取器的构建、低左心室射血分数 (LEF) 检测的模型开发以及下游评估。四个仅 ECG 数据集隐式用于开发预测器提取器，两个独立的配对数据集（ECG-ECHO 和 ECG-Note）显式用于开发和测试。, illustrating the data sources, construction of the predictor extractor, model development for low left ventricular ejection fraction (LEF) detection, and downstream evaluation. Four ECG-only datasets were implicitly used to develop the predictor extractor, and two independent paired datasets (ECG-ECHO and ECG-Note) were explicitly used for development and testing.

仅心电图数据集包括宁波The ECG-only datasets included Ningbo(Zheng et al., 2020a), 查普曼, Chapman(Zheng et al., 2020b), 代码-15%, CODE-15%(Ribeiro et al., 2021)和 PTB-XL, and PTB-XL(Wagner et al., 2020)。来自 Ningbo、Chapman 和 CODE-15% 的信息通过基于 Transformer 的模型 (ST-MEM) 的预训练权重隐式合并. Information from Ningbo, Chapman, and CODE-15% was implicitly incorporated through the pre-trained weights of a Transformer-based model (ST-MEM)(Na et al., 2024)。随后使用 PTB-XL 进行后训练以获得最终的预测器提取器。. PTB-XL was subsequently used for post-training to obtain the final predictor extractor.

为了检测 LEF，我们使用了哥伦比亚大学欧文医学中心收集的 ECG-ECHO 配对 EchoNext 数据集For the detection of LEF, we used the ECG-ECHO paired EchoNext dataset collected at Columbia University Irving Medical Center(Elias and Finer, 2025)。使用由 MIMIC-IV 构建的 ECG-Note 配对数据集进行外部验证. External validation was performed using an ECG-Note paired dataset constructed from MIMIC-IV(Johnson et al., 2024), MIMIC-IV-心电图, MIMIC-IV-ECG(Gow et al., 2023)和 MIMIC-IV-注, and MIMIC-IV-Note(Johnson et al., 2023b)，包括贝斯以色列女执事医疗中心的记录。, comprising records from Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center.

2.2 仅隐式心电图数据集Implicit ECG-only datasets

查普曼Chapman(Zheng et al., 2020b)查普曼大学、绍兴市人民医院和宁波市第一医院共同创建的“宁波心电图”和“宁波心电图”分别包含 10,646 个和 34,905 个 12 导联心电图，存储在 MUSE 心电图系统中，采样率为 500Hz，持续时间为 10 秒。代码-15%and Ningbo, created under the auspices of Chapman University, Shaoxing People’s Hospital, and Ningbo First Hospital, contains 10,646 and 34,905 12-lead ECG, respectively, stored in MUSE ECG system with a sampling rate of 500Hz and a duration of 10 seconds. Code-15%(Ribeiro et al., 2021)通过对 CODE 数据集分层采样得到is obtained through stratified sampling from the CODE dataset(Ribeiro et al., 2020)包含来自 233,770 名患者的 345,779 项检查，由米纳斯吉拉斯州远程医疗网络在 2010 年至 2016 年间收集。S12L-ECG 检查主要在初级保健机构中使用 Tecnologia Eletrônica Brasileira（巴西圣保罗）制造的远程心电图仪（型号 TEB ECGPC）或 Micromed Biotecnologia 进行（巴西利亚）—型号为 ErgoPC 13，ECG 记录的持续时间为 7 至 10 秒，采样频率范围为 300 至 600 Hz。这些数据集的处理子集隐含在传统自动心电诊断模型（传统AI-ECG模型）的预训练权重中。, containing 345,779 exams from 233,770 patients, collected by the Telehealth Network of Minas Gerais in the period between 2010 and 2016. The S12L-ECG exam was performed mostly in primary care facilities using a tele-electrocardiograph manufactured by Tecnologia Eletrônica Brasileira (São Paulo, Brazil)—model TEB ECGPC—or Micromed Biotecnologia (Brasilia, Brazil)—model ErgoPC 13 and the duration of the ECG recordings is between 7 and 10 s sampled at frequencies ranging from 300 to 600 Hz. The processed subset of these datasets are implicitly in the pre-trained weights of the traditional automatic ECG diagnosis model (the traditional AI-ECG model).

PTB-XL (Wagner et al., 2020)该数据集是由 Schiller AG 的设备在 1989 年 10 月至 1996 年 6 月期间记录的，包含来自 18885 名患者的 21,837 个临床 12 导联心电图记录，长度为 10 秒。心电图记录由最多两名心脏病专家注释，其中可能包含符合 SCP-ECG 标准的 71 种不同声明中的多个心电图声明dataset was recorded by devices from Schiller AG between October 1989 and June 1996, consisting 21,837 clinical 12-lead ECG records of 10 seconds length from 18885 patients. The ECG records were annotated by up to two cardiologists with potentially multiple ECG statements out of a set of 71 different statements conforming to the SCP-ECG standards(ISO Central Secretary., 2009)。该数据集是传统心电图解读算法的常用基准. This dataset is a commonly used benchmark for traditional ECG interpretation algorithms(Strodthoff et al., 2020)。数据集id按照8:1:1的比例分为训练集、验证集和测试集。本文中，数据集隐含在传统自动心电诊断模型（传统AI-ECG模型）的训练后权重中。. The dataset id divided into training, validation, and test sets with a ratio of 8:1:1. In this paper, the dataset is implicitly in the post-trained weights of traditional automatic ECG diagnosis models (the traditional AI-ECG model).

2.3 ECG-ECHO 和 ECG-Note 数据集ECG-ECHO and ECG-Note datasets

EchoNext 是最近发布的 ECG-ECHO 配对数据集，用于对 ECG 筛查模型进行基准测试EchoNext is a recent published ECG-ECHO paired dataset for benchmarking ECG screening models(Elias and Finer, 2025)。它涉及来自 36,286 名独特患者和 18 岁或以上患者的 82,543 条去识别的配对 ECG-ECHO 记录，这些患者在 2008 年至 2022 年的 1 年内接受了数字存储的 12 导联心电图和经胸 ECHO。该数据集分为训练、验证和测试部分。训练集中可能包含多个 ECG-ECHO 对，而验证集和测试集中仅采用最新的 ECG。 ECG 信号是从 GE MUSE ECG 管理系统中提取的，采样频率为 250 Hz，所有 12 条导联的采样频率为 10 秒。. It involves 82,543 de-identified paired ECG-ECHO records from 36,286 unique patients and those aged 18 years or older were identified, who underwent a digitally stored 12-lead ECG and a transthoracic ECHO within a 1-year interval between 2008 and 2022. The dataset is divided into training, validation, and test splits. There might includes multiple ECG-ECHO pairs in the training set, while only the latest ECG are adopted in the validation and test sets. The ECG signals were extracted from the GE MUSE ECG management system at a sampling frequency of 250 Hz across all 12 leads with 10 seconds duration.

ECG-Note数据集基于MIMIC-IV构建The ECG-Note dataset is constructed based on MIMIC-IV(Johnson et al., 2024), MIMIC-IV-心电图, MIMIC-IV-ECG(Gow et al., 2023)和 MIMIC-IV-注, and MIMIC-IV-Note(Johnson et al., 2023b)，如图所示, as illustrated in FigureA.1附录。我们最初确定了至少拥有一次标准 10 秒 12 导联心电图（采样频率为 500Hz）的成年患者，并在心电图后一年内记录了相应的临床记录。应用排除标准来删除：1）临床记录缺乏与射血分数（EF）和ECHO/TTE相关的关键词的对； 2) 心电图包含缺失数据 (NaN)。在这些排除之后，样本与 MIMIC-ECG-LVEF 进行交叉引用of the Appendix. We initially identified adult patients who possessed at least one standard 10-second 12-lead ECG with sampling frequency of 500Hz and a corresponding clinical note recorded within one year following the ECG. Exclusion criteria were applied to remove: 1) pairs where clinical notes lacked keywords related to ejection fraction(EF) and ECHO/TTE; 2) ECGs containing missing data (NaN). Following these exclusions, the samples were cross-referenced with MIMIC-ECG-LVEF(Li et al., 2025)识别一致的 ECG-EF 类别对。对于每位患者，仅保留时间间隔最短的 ECG-Note 对，最终得到 16,017 个心电图测试集。to identify consistent ECG-EF class pairs. For each patient, only the ECG-Note pair with the shortest time interval was retained, resulting in a final testing set of 16,017 ECGs.

2.4 结果Outcomes

对于 ECG-ECHO 配对数据集，左心室射血分数的值是从 Syngo Dynamics（西门子）和 Xcelera（飞利浦）提取的。标签策略是根据For the ECG-ECHO paired dataset, values of left ventricular ejection fraction were extracted from Syngo Dynamics (Siemens) and Xcelera (Philips). The labeling strategy was defined in accordance withPoterucha et al. (2025)，使用 45% 的上限来定义低左心室射血分数 (LEF)。如果在超声心动图显示射血分数之前 1 年内进行心电图检查，则心电图标记为阳性, using an upper threshold of 45% to define low left ventricular ejection fraction (LEF). An ECG was labeled positive if it was performed within 1 year prior to an echocardiogram demonstrating an ejection fraction≤\leq45%。对于确认有射血分数的患者45%. For patients confirmed to have ejection fraction>>45%，最近一次 ECHO 之前的所有心电图均标记为阴性。45%, all ECGs prior to the most recent ECHO were labeled negative.

对于 ECG-Note 配对数据集，大型语言模型For the ECG-Note paired dataset, a large language model(Qwen et al., 2025)使用改编自的修改策略using a modified strategy adapted fromGao et al. (2025)用于从 MIMIC-IV-Note 的放电表中提取射血分数值（图was employed to extract ejection fraction values from the discharge table of MIMIC-IV-Note (FigureA.1b 在附录中）。阳性类别定义为射血分数b in the Appendix). The positive class was defined as ejection fraction≤\leq45%，与 ECG-ECHO 数据集的定义一致。45%, consistent with the definition applied to the ECG-ECHO dataset.

2.5 模型开发Model development

我们开发了一个基于心电图预测驱动的 LEF 框架 (ECGPD-LEF) 用于检测 LEF。如图所示We developed an ECG-based Predictor-Driven LEF framework (ECGPD-LEF) for the detection of LEF. As illustrated in Figure1b，该框架包含两个组件：(1) 预测器提取器，从原始心电图波形生成结构化概率表示；(2) 基于预测器的推理模型，包括单预测器和多预测器方法。单预测器方法无需额外的特定于任务的训练即可执行 LEF 推理，而多预测器方法则根据提取的预测器学习轻量级表格分类器。b, the framework comprises two components: (1) a predictor extractor that generates structured probabilistic representations from raw ECG waveforms and (2) predictor-based inference models, including single-predictor and multi-predictor approaches. The single-predictor approach performs LEF inference without additional task-specific training, whereas the multi-predictor approach learns a lightweight tabular classifier based on the extracted predictors.

2.5.1 预测器提取器Predictor extractor

为了实例化预测器提取器，我们采用了基于 Transformer 的自动心电图诊断模型。具体来说，我们使用了 ST-MEM 架构To instantiate the predictor extractor, we adopted a Transformer-based automatic ECG diagnosis model. Specifically, we used the ST-MEM architecture(Na et al., 2024)，在 Chapman、Ningbo 和 CODE-15% 数据集上进行预训练。使用公开的预训练权重，我们在 PTB-XL 数据集上进一步微调模型，以预测 71 种传统心电图诊断。实施了两种训练策略：原始方法（表示为 Transformer）和前面描述的修改后的训练策略（表示为 Transformer-PT）, pre-trained on the Chapman, Ningbo, and CODE-15% datasets. Using the publicly available pre-trained weights, we further fine-tuned the model on the PTB-XL dataset to predict 71 conventional ECG diagnoses. Two training strategies were implemented: the original approach (denoted as Transformer) and a modified post-training strategy (denoted as Transformer-PT) described previously(Zhou et al., 2025)。最终的训练后模型配备了 sigmoid 激活，输出 71 种诊断中每一种的概率估计。这些概率输出被用作下游 LEF 建模任务的预测因子。. The final post-trained model, equipped with sigmoid activation, outputs probability estimates for each of the 71 diagnoses. These probabilistic outputs were used as predictors for the downstream LEF modeling task.

2.5.2 单预测器和多预测器方法Single-predictor and multi-predictor approaches

对于每个心电图记录，预测器提取器会生成 71 个范围从 0 到 1 的预测器值，每个值对应于临床定义的心电图解释。在单预测变量方法中，每个预测变量值 (PV) 均针对 LEF 检测进行独立评估，无需对 ECG-ECHO 数据集进行额外训练。对于对应于正常心电图或窦性心律的预测因子，我们使用For each ECG recording, the predictor extractor generates 71 predictor values ranging from 0 to 1, each corresponding to a clinically defined ECG interpretation. In the single-predictor approach, each predictor value (PV) was evaluated independently for LEF detection without additional training on the ECG-ECHO dataset. For predictors corresponding to normal ECG or sinus rhythm, we used(1−PV)(1-\mathrm{PV})反映其与 LEF 降低的反向临床关联；对于所有其他预测变量，直接使用原始 PV。与阈值无关的指标，包括 AUROC 和 AUPRC，是直接在测试集上计算的。对于 F1 分数，通过最大化验证集性能来选择分类阈值。to reflect their inverse clinical association with reduced LEF; for all other predictors, the original PV was used directly. Threshold-independent metrics, including AUROC and AUPRC, were computed directly on the test set. For the F1 score, the classification threshold was selected by maximizing validation-set performance.

在多预测器方法中，使用轻量级表格分类器对 71 个预测器进行联合建模。作为线性模型，我们使用逻辑回归来实现In the multi-predictor approach, the 71 predictors were jointly modeled using lightweight tabular classifiers. As a linear model, we implemented logistic regression with anl2l_{2}惩罚，通过验证集上的 {0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0} 上的网格搜索选择正则化参数。作为非线性替代方案，我们实现了 XGBoostpenalty, with the regularization parameter selected via grid search over {0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0} on the validation set. As a nonlinear alternative, we implemented XGBoost(Chen, 2016)，一种非常适合结构化数据的梯度增强决策树方法。学习率和最大树深度分别通过{0.05,0.1,0.2}和{3,5,7}上的网格搜索进行调整。估计器的数量设置为 1000，并根据验证性能提前停止（30 轮）。对于这两个模型，最终的分类阈值是通过最大化验证集上的 F1 分数来确定的。, a gradient-boosted decision tree method well suited for structured data. The learning rate and maximum tree depth were tuned via grid search over {0.05, 0.1, 0.2} and {3, 5, 7}, respectively. The number of estimators was set to 1000 with early stopping (30 rounds) based on validation performance. For both models, the final classification threshold was determined by maximizing the F1 score on the validation set.

2.6 绩效评估Performance evaluation

我们首先在 PTB-XL 测试集上评估预测器提取器，因为它构成了所提出框架的关键组成部分。随后在两个独立的数据集上评估 LEF 检测性能：内部测试集（由 ECG-ECHO 数据集的保留测试集组成）和外部测试集 ECG-Note（在本研究中构建）（图We first evaluated the predictor extractor on the PTB-XL test set, as it constitutes a key component of the proposed framework. LEF detection performance was subsequently assessed on two independent datasets: the internal test set, consisting of held-out test set from the ECG-ECHO dataset, and the external test set, ECG-Note, which was constructed in this study (Figure1）。在这些数据集上评估了单预测器方法和多预测器方法。). Both single- and multi-predictor approaches were evaluated on these datasets.

使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积 (AUROC)、精确回忆曲线下面积 (AUPRC) 和 F1 评分对模型性能进行量化，与之前的工作一致Model performance was quantified using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC), and F1 score, consistent with prior work(Poterucha et al., 2025)。置信区间是通过 1,000 次引导重采样来估计的。为了进行基准测试，我们将我们的方法与 Columbia mini 深度学习模型进行了比较. Confidence intervals were estimated via 1,000 bootstrap resamples. For benchmarking, we compared our method against the Columbia mini deep learning model(Poterucha et al., 2025)，LEF 检测的官方端到端基线，可公开获取源代码和预训练权重，从而实现可重复的比较。 Columbia mini 模型也在外部测试集上进行了评估（参见章节, the official end-to-end baseline for LEF detection, which is publicly available with source code and pre-trained weights, enabling reproducible comparison. The Columbia mini model was also evaluated on the external test set (see SectionA.3附录）。of the Appendix).

为了评估不同组件和设计选择的相对贡献，我们进一步评估了多预测器方法的多种配置，包括替代预测器提取器、表格模型和不同数量的预测器。To assess the relative contributions of different components and design choices, we further evaluated multiple configurations of the multi-predictor approach, including alternative predictor extractors, tabular models, and varying numbers of predictors.

2.7 可解释性Interpretability

预测器驱动的框架可以对单预测器方法和多预测器方法进行透明解释。在单预测方法中，每个预测值直接代表相应心电图诊断的概率，提供固有的临床可解释性。我们确定了最重要的预测因素，并使用多预测因素方法进行了组合分析。The predictor-driven framework enables transparent interpretation for both single- and multi-predictor approaches. In the single-predictor approach, each predictor value directly represents the probability of the corresponding ECG diagnosis, providing inherent clinical interpretability. We identified the most important predictors and performed combined analyses with the multi-predictor approach.

对于多重预测方法，我们采用了 SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）值For the multi-predictor approach, we employed SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) values(Shapley and others, 1953; Lundberg and Lee, 2017)量化全球和本地层面的功能贡献。 SHAP 是一种博弈论的附加特征归因方法，可提供一致且局部准确的解释to quantify feature contributions at global and local levels. SHAP is a game-theoretic, additive feature attribution method that provides consistent and locally accurate explanations(Lundberg and Lee, 2017)。为了提高基于树的模型的计算效率，我们使用了 Tree SHAP 算法. For computational efficiency in tree-based models, we used the Tree SHAP algorithm(Lundberg et al., 2018)。全局解释图包括累积贡献、蜂群摘要以及 SHAP 与预测变量值图，以识别关键预测变量并表征其在模型中的行为。局部图突出显示了十个预测变量 SHAP 值，并显示了相对于 ECG 诊断阈值和 LEF 决策阈值的预测概率，从而有助于解释各个模型的预测。. Global explanation plots included cumulative contributions, beeswarm summaries, and SHAP versus predictor value plots to identify key predictors and characterize their behavior in the model. Local plots highlighted the ten predictors SHAP values and displayed predicted probabilities relative to both the ECG diagnosis thresholds and the LEF decision thresholds, facilitating interpretation of individual model predictions.

2.8 亚组分析Subgroup analysis

我们在内部和外部测试集中评估了临床相关亚组的模型性能。在内部测试集中，预定义的亚组包括是否存在其他结构性心脏病 (SHD)、瓣膜性心脏病 (VHD)、年龄组、性别、种族/民族和临床背景（SHD 和 VHD 的定义在第 1 节中提供）We evaluated model performance across clinically relevant subgroups in both the internal and external test sets. In the internal test set, predefined subgroups included the presence or absence of other structural heart disease (SHD), valvular heart disease (VHD), age groups, sex, race/ethnicity, and clinical context (definitions of SHD and VHD are provided in SectionB.1附录）。在外部测试集中，对可用变量进行了亚组评估，包括年龄组、性别、种族/民族和临床背景。of the Appendix). In the external test set, subgroup evaluation was performed for the available variables, including age groups, sex, race/ethnicity, and clinical context.

3 结果Results

3.1 人口特征Population characteristics

ECG-ECHO (EchoNext) 队列是一个公开的基准，包含 82,543 项心电图检查，根据官方协议分为训练集 (n=72,475)、验证集 (n=4,626) 和内部测试集 (n=5,442)The ECG-ECHO (EchoNext) cohort is a publicly available benchmark comprising 82,543 ECG examinations, partitioned into training (n=72,475), validation (n=4,626), and internal test (n=5,442) sets according to the official protocol(Poterucha et al., 2025)。我们进一步构建了一个外部队列（ECG-Note；n=16,017）作为独立测试集（图. We further constructed an external cohort (ECG-Note; n=16,017) as an independent test set (FigureA.1）。表总结了基线人口统计学和临床特征). Baseline demographic and clinical characteristics are summarized in Table1.

与内部测试队列相比，外部队列中男性患者 (54.9%) 和白人 (73.0%) 的比例较高，而 ECG-ECHO 队列中的种族/民族代表性分布更为均匀。临床背景分布也存在很大差异，外部队列的紧急情况（57.3%）丰富，而内部测试队列中的紧急情况（36.2%）、住院患者（40.5%）和门诊患者（19.5%）分布更均匀。这些差异反映了不同队列之间显着的人口统计学和临床​​异质性。 71 个提取的预测变量的分布详见附录表Compared with the internal test cohort, the external cohort exhibited a higher proportion of male patients (54.9%) and White individuals (73.0%), whereas racial/ethnic representation in the ECG-ECHO cohort was more evenly distributed. Clinical context distributions also differed substantially, with the external cohort enriched for emergency encounters (57.3%) compared with the more evenly distributed emergency (36.2%), inpatient (40.5%), and outpatient (19.5%) settings in the internal test cohort. These differences reflect substantial demographic and clinical heterogeneity across cohorts. The distribution of the 71 extracted predictors is detailed in Appendix TableLABEL:tab:num_echonext_2，它还显示了选定预测变量（包括 NORM 和 ILBBB）的二值化计数的差异。, which also shows differences in binarized counts for selected predictors, including NORM and ILBBB.

3.2 预测器提取器识别预测器Predictor recognition by the predictor extractor

可靠的预测变量提取是下游 LEF 建模的先决条件。 Transformer-PT 的宏观 AUROC 为 94.5%，AUPRC 为 41.4%，F1 得分为 38.3%，优于原始 Transformer（AUROC 89.8%，AUPRC 30.7%），并且表现出与之前报道的 PTB-XL 上最先进结果相当的性能Reliable predictor extraction is a prerequisite for downstream LEF modeling. Transformer-PT achieved a macro AUROC of 94.5%, AUPRC of 41.4%, and F1 score of 38.3%, outperforming the original Transformer (AUROC 89.8%, AUPRC 30.7%) and demonstrating performance comparable to previously reported state-of-the-art results on PTB-XL(Zhou et al., 2025)。 10 个代表性预测变量的分类性能如表所示. Classification performance for 10 representative predictors is shown in Table2，附录表中提供了所有 71 个预测变量的结果, with results for all 71 predictors provided in Appendix TableLABEL:tab:results_single_predictor-2。在预测变量中，Transformer-PT 始终实现强大的判别能力（如 AUROC 值所反映），而 AUPRC 和 F1 由于类别不平衡而有所不同（请参阅附录部分）. Across predictors, Transformer-PT achieved consistently strong discriminative capacity as reflected by AUROC values, whereas AUPRC and F1 varied due to class imbalance (see Appendix SectionC.1）。重要的是，下游 LEF 框架利用连续预测分数，而不是依赖阈值的二元决策；因此，Transformer-PT 强大的排名性能足以确保可靠的信息传输到后续建模阶段，即使对于超稀有类别也是如此。). Importantly, the downstream LEF framework leverages continuous predictor scores rather than threshold-dependent binary decisions; thus, the strong ranking performance of Transformer-PT is sufficient to ensure reliable information transfer to subsequent modeling stages, even for ultra-rare categories.

3.3 单预测器方法性能Single-predictor approach performance

我们评估了个体预测器使用其连续输出分数检测 LEF 的能力，无需针对特定任务进行微调（零样本推理）。表中总结了内部测试集中 10 个代表性预测变量的结果We evaluated the ability of individual predictors to detect LEF using their continuous output scores, without task-specific fine-tuning (zero-shot-like inference). Results for 10 representative predictors in the internal test set are summarized in Table2，其余预测变量和外部测试集的结果在附录表中提供, with results for the remaining predictors and the external test set provided in Appendix TablesLABEL:tab:results_single_predictor-2和andLABEL:tab:results_single_predictor-2-ecgnote。预测变量按内部测试集中 F1 分数递减排序。值得注意的是，几个预测变量表现出了显着的独立判别性能。八个预测变量（NORM、ILBBB、INJAL、ISCLA、ANEUR、ISCAL、ASMI 和 SVARR）在内部实现了 71.0% 到 81.0% 之间的 AUROC 值，其中五个在外部保持 AUROC 值在 70.7% 到 78.8% 之间。 NORM 预测因子是两个队列中最强的个体预测因子，内部产生 AUROC 81.0%、AUPRC 47.4% 和 F1 得分 51.4%，外部 AUROC 78.8%、AUPRC 36.2% 和 F1 得分 42.3%。在心电图异常诊断中，ILBBB 和 INJAL 的判别性能最高，内部 AUROC 分别为 80.0% 和 75.3%，外部 AUROC 分别为 73.4% 和 71.6%。. Predictors are ordered by decreasing F1 score in the internal test set. Notably, several predictors demonstrated substantial standalone discriminative performance. Eight predictors (NORM, ILBBB, INJAL, ISCLA, ANEUR, ISCAL, ASMI, and SVARR) achieved AUROC values ranging from 71.0% to 81.0% internally, with five maintaining AUROC values between 70.7% and 78.8% externally. The NORM predictor was the strongest individual predictor in both cohorts, yielding an AUROC of 81.0%, AUPRC of 47.4%, and F1 score of 51.4% internally, and an AUROC of 78.8%, AUPRC of 36.2%, and F1 score of 42.3% externally. Among abnormal ECG diagnoses, ILBBB and INJAL achieved the highest discriminative performance, with internal AUROCs of 80.0% and 75.3%, and external AUROCs of 73.4% and 71.6%, respectively.

在所有 71 个预测变量中，判别性能差异很大。尽管如此，大多数预测因子（内部测试集中的 58 个和外部测试集中的 54 个）的 AUROC 值均高于机会水平 (50%)，这表明 LEF 相关信息分布在不同的 ECG 衍生预测因子中，而不是局限于诊断的一小部分。当集成到下一小节中描述的多预测器模型中时，独立性能较弱的预测器仍然会带来增量改进。Across all 71 predictors, discriminative performance varied substantially. Nevertheless, the majority of predictors, 58 in the internal test set and 54 in the external test set, achieved AUROC values above chance level (50%), suggesting that LEF-related information is distributed across diverse ECG-derived predictors rather than confined to a small subset of diagnoses. Predictors with weaker standalone performance still contributed incremental improvements when integrated into the multi-predictor model described in the next subsection.

另一项观察结果是，最佳 LEF 检测阈值始终显着低于用于传统心电图分类的阈值。例如，虽然 NORM 预测因子的阈值 0.370 可以识别异常心电图，但 LEF 检测的最佳阈值要低得多，即 0.003641，大多数预测因子都观察到类似的模式（附录图An additional observation was that optimal LEF detection thresholds were consistently substantially lower than those used for conventional ECG classification. For example, while a threshold of 0.370 for the NORM predictor identified abnormal ECGs, a substantially lower threshold of 0.003641 was optimal for LEF detection, with similar patterns observed across most predictors (Appendix FigureC.1).

3.4 多预测器方法性能Multi-predictor approach performance

我们评估了预测器提取器和表格模型组合的 ECGPD-LEF 多预测器框架，以官方端到端 Columbia 迷你模型为基准We evaluated the ECGPD-LEF multi-predictor framework across combinations of predictor extractors and tabular models, benchmarking against the official end-to-end Columbia mini model(Poterucha et al., 2025)（表(Table3）。在所有配置中，XGBoost 与经过训练的 Transformer 预测器提取器 (Transformer-PT-XGBoost) 相结合，在内部和外部测试集上均取得了最高性能。在内部测试集中，Transformer-PT-XGBoost 的 AUROC 为 88.4%（95% CI，87.1–89.5），AUPRC 为 69.2%（66.2–72.0），F1 分数为 64.5%（62.2–66.7），显着优于 Columbia mini 模型，后者的 AUROC 为 85.2% (83.9–86.5)，AUPRC 为 59.9% (56.6–63.3)，F1 分数为 57.9% (55.4–60.3)，置信区间不重叠。在外部测试集中观察到类似的性能改进（表). Among all configurations, XGBoost combined with the post-trained Transformer predictor extractor (Transformer-PT-XGBoost) achieved the highest performance in both internal and external test sets. In the internal test set, Transformer-PT-XGBoost yielded an AUROC of 88.4% (95% CI, 87.1–89.5), an AUPRC of 69.2% (66.2–72.0), and an F1 score of 64.5% (62.2–66.7), significantly outperforming the Columbia mini model, which achieved an AUROC of 85.2% (83.9–86.5), an AUPRC of 59.9% (56.6–63.3), and an F1 score of 57.9% (55.4–60.3), with non-overlapping confidence intervals. Comparable performance improvements were observed in the external test set (Table3).

为了理清各个组件的贡献，我们对内部测试集进行了受控比较（表To disentangle the contributions of individual components, we conducted controlled comparisons on the internal test set (Table3;图; Figure2）。在预测器提取器保持不变的情况下，XGBoost 的 Transformer 和 Transformer-PT 的性能始终优于逻辑回归，其中 Transformer-PT 的增益最大（AUROC +3.5 个百分点；AUPRC +11.4 个百分点）。保持表格模型不变，预测器提取器（Transformer-PT 与 Transformer）的后训练在所有指标上都产生了一致的改进。). Holding the predictor extractor constant, XGBoost consistently outperformed logistic regression for both Transformer and Transformer-PT, with the largest gains observed for Transformer-PT (AUROC +3.5 percentage points; AUPRC +11.4 points). Holding the tabular model constant, post-training of the predictor extractor (Transformer-PT vs. Transformer) yielded consistent improvements across all metrics.

我们进一步检查了性能，因为预测变量按照单预测变量 F1 分数的降序逐渐添加到表格模型中。在所有配置中，通过额外的预测器，性能普遍得到改善，Transformer-PT-XGBoost 在所有预测器计数和指标中始终实现最高性能（图We further examined performance as predictors were progressively added to the tabular model in descending order of single-predictor F1 score. Across configurations, performance generally improved with additional predictors, with Transformer-PT-XGBoost consistently achieving the highest performance across all predictor counts and metrics (Figure2b-d）。其他配置也遵循类似的趋势，但没有超过 AUROC 或 AUPRC 的 Columbia mini 模型基线，即使在各自的峰值性能下也是如此。b-d). Other configurations followed similar trends but did not exceed the Columbia mini model baseline for AUROC or AUPRC, even at their respective peak performance.

3.5 型号说明Model explanation

ECGPD-LEF 的表格组件通过 SHAP 分析实现全局和局部可解释性。我们在内部测试集上分析了 Transformer-PT-XGBoost（图The tabular component of ECGPD-LEF enables both global and local interpretability via SHAP analysis. We analyzed Transformer-PT-XGBoost on the internal test set (Figure3, 图, Figure4）。在全球层面，累积 SHAP 贡献随着模型中包含的预测变量数量的增加而增加（图). 4 讨论Discussion

4.1 LEF 检测的结构化范例A structured paradigm for LEF detection

在这项研究中，我们提出了一种结构化预测集成框架（ECGPD-LEF），用于基于心电图检测左心室功能下降，这与传统的端到端波形建模不同。正确的多预测器配置 (Transformer-PT-XGBoost) 在内部保留测试集（AUROC 88.4%，F1 64.5%）和外部测试集（AUROC 86.8%，F1 53.6%）中表现出强大的性能，显着优于最近强大的端到端基线 Columbia mini 模型In this study, we propose a structured predictor-integration framework (ECGPD-LEF) for ECG-based detection of reduced left ventricular function that departs from conventional end-to-end waveform modeling. The proper multi-predictor configuration (Transformer-PT-XGBoost) demonstrated robust performance in both the internal hold-out test set (AUROC 88.4%, F1 64.5%) and the external test set (AUROC 86.8%, F1 53.6%), significantly outperforming a recent strong end-to-end baseline, the Columbia mini model(Poterucha et al., 2025)（内部 AUROC 85.2%，F1 57.9%；外部 AUROC 80.7%，F1 46.4%）。根据年龄、性别、种族/民族、临床背景以及是否存在结构性或瓣膜性心脏病定义的亚组均保持了性能增益，支持了该方法的普遍性。在这种基于预测器的架构中，多种临床可识别的 ECG 诊断，包括 NORM、ILBBB 和 INJAL，与 LEF 检测密切相关（内部 AUROC 75.3%–81.0%；外部 AUROC 71.6%–78.6%），从而能够透明地解释模型输出。作为基于现有心电图诊断模型的轻量级扩展，这种结构化框架提供了改进的辨别力，同时保留了模块化和临床可解释性。(internal AUROC 85.2%, F1 57.9%; external AUROC 80.7%, F1 46.4%). Performance gains were maintained across subgroups defined by age, sex, race/ethnicity, clinical context, and the presence or absence of structural or valvular heart disease, supporting the generalizability of the approach. Within this predictor-based architecture, several clinically recognizable ECG diagnoses, including NORM, ILBBB, and INJAL, were strongly associated with LEF detection (internal AUROC 75.3%–81.0%; external AUROC 71.6%–78.6%), enabling transparent interpretation of model outputs. As a lightweight extension built upon an existing ECG diagnosis model, this structured framework provides improved discrimination while preserving modularity and clinical interpretability.

4.2 需要公开基准的 AI-ECG 评估The need for publicly benchmarked AI-ECG evaluation

应用于心电图的人工智能在新兴任务中表现出了强大的性能，包括主动脉瓣狭窄、三尖瓣反流和左心室功能障碍的检测。然而，大多数先前的模型都是在特定于机构的私人数据集上开发和评估的，这些数据集具有异质的人口特征和结果定义，限制了再现性并阻碍了严格的跨模型比较。早期作品由Artificial intelligence applied to ECG has demonstrated strong performance in emerging tasks, including detection of aortic stenosis, tricuspid regurgitation and left ventricular dysfunction. However, most prior models have been developed and evaluated on institution-specific private datasets with heterogeneous population characteristics and outcome definitions, limiting reproducibility and preventing rigorous cross-model comparison. Early work byAttia et al. (2019)对 44,959 名患者训练了一个卷积神经网络，以识别定义为射血分数的心室功能障碍trained a convolutional neural network on 44,959 patients to identify ventricular dysfunction defined as ejection fraction≤\leq35%，在同一机构进行前瞻性验证35%, with prospective validation performed at the same institution(Attia and others, 2019)。随后的改进将检测范围扩展到射血分数. Subsequent refinements extended detection to ejection fraction≤\leq40% 并报告仅使用数字心电图输入进行多站点验证40% and reported multisite validation using digital ECG input alone(Carter et al., 2026)。尽管这些研究取得了很强的区分度，但缺乏可公开访问的基准数据集限制了透明的评估。最近，. Although these studies achieved strong discrimination, the absence of publicly accessible benchmarking datasets constrains transparent evaluation. Recently,Poterucha et al. (2025)通过发布包含 36,286 名独特患者的去识别化心电图数据集来解决这一差距，该数据集具有预定义的训练、验证和测试分组，并通过对基线模型（哥伦比亚迷你模型）进行基准测试，该模型实现了与在更大的专有队列上训练的模型相当的区分度。通过提供标准化的数据划分、模型权重和开源代码，这项工作为AI-ECG研究建立了一个透明且可重复的评估框架，在此基础上我们的研究能够进行严格和公平的比较。此外，为了将验证扩展到单个基准数据集之外，我们使用公开数据集和大型语言模型开发了 ECG-Note，为 LEF 检测建立了额外的外部验证数据集，以捕获不同的患者群体和临床背景。addressed this gap by releasing a de-identified ECG dataset comprising 36,286 unique patients with predefined training, validation, and test splits, and by benchmarking a baseline model (the Columbia mini model) that achieved discrimination comparable to models trained on substantially larger proprietary cohorts. By providing standardized data partitions, model weights, and open-source code, this work established a transparent and reproducible evaluation framework for AI-ECG research, upon which our study enables rigorous and fair comparison. Furthermore, to extend validation beyond a single benchmarked dataset, we developed ECG-Note using publicly available datasets and large language models, establishing an additional external validation dataset for LEF detection that captures diverse patient populations and clinical contexts.

4.3 超越端到端黑盒建模Moving beyond end-to-end black-box modeling

大多数治疗左心室功能障碍的 AI-ECG 方法都依赖于端到端深度学习架构Most AI-ECG approaches for left ventricular dysfunction have relied on end-to-end deep learning architectures(Attia et al., 2019; Attia and others, 2019; Carter et al., 2026; Poterucha et al., 2025)。虽然此类模型实现了强大的预测性能，但其有限的可解释性给临床整合带来了挑战，特别是在超出基于既定心电图原理的传统心电图标准的应用中。在缺乏透明的机械推理的情况下，黑盒预测可能难以与既定的诊断框架相一致，从而可能限制临床医生的信任和采用。提高透明度的努力包括根据 555 个离散心电图测量构建表格模型. While such models achieve strong predictive performance, their limited interpretability poses challenges for clinical integration, particularly in applications that extend beyond conventional ECG criteria grounded in established ECG principles. In the absence of transparent mechanistic reasoning, black-box predictions may be difficult to reconcile with established diagnostic frameworks, potentially limiting clinician trust and adoption. Efforts to enhance transparency have included tabular models constructed from 555 discrete ECG measurements(Hughes et al., 2024)。虽然更容易解释，但这些方法依赖于专有的商业测量算法，这些算法可能因心电图平台而异. Although more interpretable, these approaches depend on proprietary commercial measurement algorithms that may vary across ECG platforms(Strodthoff et al., 2023)，从而限制了普遍性和标准化的外部评估。相比之下，我们引入了一种结构化表示范式，它将深度学习的预测能力与表格建模的可解释性相结合。每个预测因子都对应于临床上有意义的特征，并且不依赖于特定于供应商的测量管道。在公开基准设置中，该方法表现出比端到端 Columbia 迷你模型更高的性能，支持临床可解释且高性能的 AI-ECG 系统的可行性。, thereby constraining generalizability and standardized external evaluation. In contrast, we introduce a structured representation paradigm that integrates the predictive capacity of deep learning with the interpretability of tabular modeling. Each predictor corresponds to clinically meaningful features and it does not rely on vendor-specific measurement pipelines. Within the publicly benchmarked setting, this approach demonstrates improved performance over the end-to-end Columbia mini model, supporting the feasibility of clinically interpretable yet high-performing AI-ECG systems.

4.4 可解释性揭示了 LEF 检测的临床意义指标Interpretability reveals clinically meaningful indicators for LEF detection

可解释性分析确定了具有诊断信息的预测因子，为 LEF 检测提供了机制见解。在单预测器设置中，经过训练的传统心电图诊断模型的连续概率输出足以以类似零样本的方式实现有意义的区分。例如，仅 NORM 的预测概率产生的内部 AUROC 为 81.0%，外部 AUROC 为 78.6%。重要的是，这并不意味着 NORM 的二元诊断直接指示 LEF。相反，连续概率输出远低于临床决策阈值，捕获与 LEF 密切相关的正常心电图模式的分级偏差。这一发现表明，深度神经网络在其概率表示中编码亚临床心电图变化，即使这些变化没有跨越传统的诊断边界，这为之前的观察提供了潜在的解释，即大规模深度学习模型可以从细微的信号变化中检测出新的心血管表型。在多预测框架内，SHAP 分析证明了预测变量之间一致的重要性模式。在人口层面（图Interpretability analyses identified diagnostically informative predictors that provide mechanistic insight into LEF detection. In the single-predictor setting, continuous probability outputs from the trained traditional ECG diagnosis model were sufficient to achieve meaningful discrimination in a zero-shot-like manner. For example, the predicted probability of NORM alone yielded an internal AUROC of 81.0% and an external AUROC of 78.6%. Importantly, this does not imply that the binary diagnosis of NORM directly indicates LEF. Rather, the continuous probability output, well below the clinical decision threshold, captures graded deviations from normal ECG patterns that are strongly associated with LEF. This finding suggests that deep neural networks encode subclinical ECG variations within their probabilistic representations, even when such variations do not cross conventional diagnostic boundaries, offering a potential explanation for prior observations that large-scale deep learning models can detect novel cardiovascular phenotypes from subtle signal alterations. Within the multi-predictor framework, SHAP analyses demonstrated consistent importance patterns across predictors. At the population level (Figure3），SHAP 值在概率范围内变化很大，表明 ECG 得出的诊断概率的分级变化对 LEF 风险估计有重要贡献。在个人层面（图), SHAP values varied substantially across probability ranges, indicating that graded shifts in ECG-derived diagnostic probabilities contribute meaningfully to LEF risk estimation. At the individual level (Figure4），本地解释强调了驱动每个决策的预测因素，并为模型的推理提供了人类可解释的见解（图), local explanations highlighted the predictors driving each decision and provided human-interpretable insights into the model’s reasoning (Figures4c-d）。总之，这些发现表明，LEF 相关的心电图特征可以分解为临床可识别的诊断维度的组合，从而增强所提出框架的结构透明度。c-d). Together, these findings suggest that LEF-associated ECG signatures may be decomposed into combinations of clinically recognizable diagnostic dimensions, enhancing the structural transparency of the proposed framework.

4.5 亚组分析证明了跨人群的稳健性Subgroup analysis demonstrates robustness across populations

亚组分析表明，ECGPD-LEF 在不同的人口和临床阶层（包括年龄、性别、种族/民族和护理环境）中保持了一致的歧视性表现。在所有评估的亚组中，ECGPD-LEF 在 AUROC、AUPRC 和 F1 评分方面均优于 Columbia Mini 模型。值得注意的是，在患有或不患有结构性心脏病 (SHD) 或瓣膜性心脏病 (VHD) 的患者中，表现保持稳定，这表明 ECGPD-LEF 捕获的心电图特征不仅代表共存的结构异常，而且反映了与 LEF 特异性相关的信号成分。尽管某些种族亚组的代表性有限（例如，亚洲参与者占训练队列的 3.6%），但在内部和外部验证队列中观察到了类似的表现（AUROC 分别为 92.5% 和 91.0%），支持了该框架的普遍性和潜在的临床适用性。Subgroup analyses demonstrated that ECGPD-LEF maintained consistent discriminatory performance across diverse demographic and clinical strata, including age, sex, race/ethnicity, and care settings. Across all evaluated subgroups, ECGPD-LEF outperformed the Columbia Mini model in terms of AUROC, AUPRC, and F1 score. Notably, performance remained stable in patients with and without concomitant structural heart disease (SHD) or valvular heart disease (VHD), suggesting that the ECG signatures captured by ECGPD-LEF are not merely proxies for coexisting structural abnormalities but instead reflect signal components specifically associated with LEF. Despite limited representation of certain racial subgroups (e.g., Asian participants comprising 3.6% of the training cohort), comparable performance was observed in both internal and external validation cohorts (AUROC 92.5% and 91.0%, respectively), supporting the generalizability and potential clinical applicability of the framework.

4.6 框架的可扩展性和可扩展性Scalability and extensibility of the framework

所提出的 ECGPD-LEF 框架展示了跨多个维度的可扩展性和可扩展性。首先，其模块化设计能够与临床实践中越来越多地采用的现有心电图诊断模型集成，从而允许对当前人工智能心电图系统进行轻量级扩展，而无需完全更换架构。其次，使用 Transformer-PT 主干观察到的性能改进（表The proposed ECGPD-LEF framework exhibits scalability and extensibility across multiple dimensions. First, its modular design enables integration with existing ECG diagnostic models that are increasingly adopted in clinical practice, allowing lightweight extension of current AI-ECG systems without requiring full architectural replacement. Second, performance improvements observed with the Transformer-PT backbone (Table3）表明上游心电图诊断模型的进步可能直接转化为增强的 LEF 检测。随着心电图诊断模型随着更大、更高质量的数据集不断发展，预计会取得进一步的进展。第三，基于预测器的结构本质上是可扩展的。在这项研究中，我们纳入了源自 PTB-XL 的 71 个诊断预测变量，并观察到模型性能随着表格组件中包含的预测变量数量而变化（图) suggest that advances in upstream ECG diagnostic models may directly translate into enhanced LEF detection. As ECG diagnostic models continue to evolve with larger and higher-quality datasets, further gains may be anticipated. Third, the predictor-based structure is inherently expandable. In this study, we incorporated 71 diagnostic predictors derived from PTB-XL, and observed that model performance scaled with the number of predictors included in the tabular component (Figures2和and3a).其他临床确立的心电图诊断特征a). Additional clinically established ECG diagnostic features(Cardiovascular Committee of China Medical Women’s Association et al., 2023)可以合并在同一框架内，从而无需进行根本性的架构重新设计即可进行渐进式细化。这些属性共同强调了未来 AI-ECG 开发框架的可扩展性和可扩展性。may be incorporated within the same framework, enabling progressive refinement without fundamental architectural redesign. Together, these properties underscore the scalability and extensibility of the framework for future AI-ECG development.

4.7 局限性和未来方向Limitations and future directions

尽管与最新的深度学习基线相比，ECGPD-LEF 具有良好的性能和稳健性，但仍有一些局限性值得考虑。首先，多预测框架是使用源自 ECHO 报告的标签开发的，这些标签可能会受到超声解释中观察者间差异的影响。尽管对 MIMIC-IV-Note 队列的外部验证（包括来自异构心脏成像来源的数据）部分缓解了这种担忧，但不能完全排除潜在的标签不一致问题。其次，虽然 EchoNext 和 MIMIC-IV-Note 数据集都包含不同的人群，但需要在更大的国际队列中进行进一步验证，以确保广泛的普遍性。第三，由于大规模公共心电图语料库的可用性有限，预测器提取器在中等大小的心电图诊断数据集上进行了预训练。利用更大、高质量的心电图诊断数据集可以进一步增强特征表示和下游 LEF 检测性能。未来的工作应探索扩展策略和前瞻性临床验证，以确认现实世界的临床适用性。Despite the favorable performance and robustness of ECGPD-LEF compared with the latest deep learning baseline, several limitations warrant consideration. First, the multi-predictor framework was developed using labels derived from ECHO reports, which may be subject to inter-observer variability in ultrasound interpretation. Although external validation on the MIMIC-IV-Note cohort—comprising data from heterogeneous cardiac imaging sources—partially mitigates this concern, potential labeling inconsistencies cannot be fully excluded. Second, while both the EchoNext and MIMIC- IV-Note datasets include diverse populations, further validation in larger, international cohorts is warranted to ensure broad generalizability. Third, the predictor extractor was pretrained on a moderately sized ECG diagnosis dataset due to the limited availability of large-scale public ECG corpora. Leveraging larger, high-quality ECG diagnosis datasets may further enhance feature representation and downstream LEF detection performance. Future work should explore scaling strategies and prospective clinical validation to confirm real-world clinical applicability.

5 结论Conclusion

总之，ECGPD-LEF 为基于心电图的 LEF 检测提供了一个临床可解释的、模块化的、高性能的框架。通过构建现有的心电图诊断模型，与强大的黑盒基线相比，它实现了卓越的性能，同时保持轻量级和可扩展性。基于结构化预测器的设计可实现透明的解释，揭示具有临床意义的 LEF 指标，例如 NORM 和其他预测器的概率输出。通过结合准确性、稳定性和可解释性，该框架为现实临床应用提供了实用且可扩展的筛选工具。In summary, ECGPD-LEF provides a clinically interpretable, modular, and high-performing framework for ECG-based detection of LEF. By building upon existing ECG diagnostic models, it achieves superior performance compared with strong black-box baselines, while remaining lightweight and scalable. The structured predictor-based design enables transparent interpretation, revealing clinically meaningful indicators of LEF, such as probabilistic outputs from NORM and other predictors. By combining accuracy, stability, and interpretability, this framework provides a practical and scalable screening tool for real-world clinical applications.

表TableLABEL:tab:num_echonext_2总结了 ECG-ECHO 和 ECG-Note 数据集的剩余群体特征，由传统自动心电图诊断模型 (Transformer-PT) 估计。应该强调的是，这些特征来自基于模型的预测，而不是来自原始数据收集过程的直接注释。 根据这些估计，这些数据集涵盖了广泛的诊断心电图预测因子。summarizes the remaining population characteristics of the ECG-ECHO and ECG-Note datasets, as estimated by a traditional automatic ECG diagnosis model (Transformer-PT). A.2 外部测试集的构建Construction of the external test set

我们构建了外部测试集 ECG-Note 如图We constructed the external test set ECG-Note as FigureA.1。成年患者，在 MIMIC-IV 心电图检查后一年内至少进行过一次标准 10 秒 12 导联心电图检查和至少一份临床记录. Adult patients, who had at least one standard 10 s 12-lead ECG and at least one clinical note within one year following the ECG from MIMIC-IV(Johnson et al., 2024), MIMIC-IV-心电图, MIMIC-IV-ECG(Gow et al., 2023)和 MIMIC-IV-注, and MIMIC-IV-Note(Johnson et al., 2023b)，最初被考虑，产生了来自 103,505 名患者的 1,113,547 个心电图注释对的起始池，其中包含 521,654 个心电图和 247,313 个注释。排除标准包括： 1) ECG-Note 对，其中临床记录不包含与射血分数 (EF) 和 Echo/TTE 相关的关键词； 2) ECG-Note 对，其中 ECG 包含 NaN 数据。排除后，纳入了 37,234 名患者的 382,​​308 个 ECG-Note 配对数据，包括 246,543 个 ECG 和 62,023 个笔记，以供进一步分析。 对于注释集，我们采用了大型语言模型 (LLM)，特别是 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, were initially considered, leading to a starting pool of 1,113,547 ECG- note pairs from 103,505 patients with 521,654 ECGs and 247,313 notes. Exclusion criteria included: 1) ECG-Note pairs where the clinical note did not contain keywords related to ejection fraction(EF) and Echo/TTE; 2) ECG-Note pairs where the ECG contained NaN data. After exclusions, 382,308 ECG-Note paired data of 37,234 patients, comprising 246,543 ECGs and 62,023 notes, were included for further analysis. For the note set, we employed a Large Language Model (LLM), specifically Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct(Qwen et al., 2025)，提取仅从并发 Echo/TTE 导出的精确射血分数 (EF) 值（图 1）。, to extract precise ejection fraction(EF) values derived solely from the concurrent Echo/TTE (Fig.A.1b).根据LLM获得的值，我们确定射血分数是否为b). Based on the values obtained by the LLM, we determined whether the ejection fraction was≤\leq45%，表明收缩功能中度降低。这些标签与 MIMIC-ECG-LVEF 交叉引用45%, suggesting moderately reduced systolic function. These labels were cross-referenced with MIMIC-ECG-LVEF(Li et al., 2025)识别一致的 ECG-EF 类别对，从而收集 55,318 个可用 ECG。为了保证后续评估的准确性，有效样本中只保留每位患者时间间隔最短的ECG-Note对，最终得到16,017个ECG的测试集。to identify consistent ECG-EF class pairs, resulting in the collection of 55,318 available ECGs. To ensure the accuracy of subsequent evaluations, only the ECG-Note pair with the shortest time interval for each patient was retained among the valid samples, resulting in a final testing set of 16,017 ECGs.

A.3 与外部测试集的 Columbia mini 模型对比Comparison with the Columbia mini model in the external test set

在 ECG-Note 数据集中，我们将提出的 ECGPD-EF 与 Columbia mini 模型进行了比较In the ECG-Note dataset, we compared the proposed ECGPD-EF with the Columbia mini model(Poterucha et al., 2025)。 ECGPD-EF 仅需要原始 ECG 信号进行推理。相比之下，除了 ECG 波形之外，Columbia mini 模型还需要七个表格特征：性别、年龄、PR 间期、QRS 持续时间、校正 QT 间期 (QTc)、心房率和心室率。虽然年龄和性别是直接从人口统计记录中获得的，但其余五个心电图指标并没有明确可用，而是使用. ECGPD-EF requires only raw ECG signals for inference. In contrast, the Columbia mini model requires seven tabular features in addition to the ECG waveform: sex, age, PR interval, QRS duration, corrected QT interval (QTc), atrial rate, and ventricular rate. While age and sex were directly obtained from demographic records, the remaining five electrocardiographic metrics were not explicitly available and were derived using the机器测量machine_measurements来自 MIMIC-IV ECG 模块的表。具体来说，让table from the MIMIC-IV ECG module. Specifically, letTPo​n​s​e​tT_{P_{onset}}, TQ​R​So​n​s​e​tT_{QRS_{onset}}, TQ​R​Se​n​dT_{QRS_{end}}, 和, andTTe​n​dT_{T_{end}}分别表示 P 波起始、QRS 起始、QRS 偏移和 T 波偏移的时序，令denote the timings of P-wave onset, QRS onset, QRS offset, and T-wave offset, respectively, and letR​RRR表示 RR 间隔（以毫秒为单位）。 PR 间期计算如下denote the RR interval in milliseconds. The PR interval was calculated asTQ​R​So​n​s​e​t−TPo​n​s​e​tT_{QRS_{onset}}-T_{P_{onset}}，QRS 时限推导为, and the QRS duration was derived asTQ​R​Se​n​d−TQ​R​So​n​s​e​tT_{QRS_{end}}-T_{QRS_{onset}}。 QTc 间期使用 Bazett 公式计算：. The QTc interval was computed using Bazett’s formula:(TTe​n​d−TQ​R​So​n​s​e​t)/R​R/1000(T_{T_{end}}-T_{QRS_{onset}})/\sqrt{RR/1000}。心室率计算如下. B.2 外部测试集中多预测方法的子组分析Subgroup analysis for multi-predictor method in the external test set

为了评估模型在患者特征和临床环境中的稳健性和公平性，我们进行了亚组分析，将我们提出的 Transformer-PT-XGBoost 与 Columbia mini 模型进行比较。亚组根据年龄、性别、种族和民族以及临床背景进行定义。执行 MIMIC-IV 和 MIMIC-IV-ECG 数据集之间的数据链接以提取这些子组属性。通过利用时不变间隔方法恢复时间对齐，在采集心电图时专门重新计算患者年龄To evaluate model robustness and fairness across patient characteristics and clinical settings, we conducted a subgroup analysis comparing our proposed Transformer-PT-XGBoost with Columbia mini model. Subgroups were defined by age, sex, race and ethnicity, and clinical context. Data linkage between the MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-ECG datasets was performed to extract these subgroup attributes. Patient age was recalculated specifically at the time of ECG acquisition by leveraging the time-invariant interval method to restore temporal alignment(Johnson et al., 2023a)。对于种族和民族，我们将细粒度类别聚合为更广泛的集群（表. For race and ethnicity, we aggregated granular categories into broader clusters (TableB.3）。关于临床背景，我们通过将心电图时间戳映射到相应的医院入院和出院窗口来确定入院类型。所有性能指标均使用 AUROC 和 AUPRC 报告（表). Regarding clinical context, we determined the admission type by mapping the ECG timestamp to the corresponding hospital admission and discharge window. All performance metrics are reported using the AUROC and the AUPRC (TableB.2).

总体而言，我们的模型在几乎所有亚组中都表现出可比或优越的性能，这表明所提出的模型在异质患者群体和护理环境中具有良好的泛化性，支持其在现实世界部署场景中的潜在效用。Overall, our model demonstrates comparable or superior performance across almost all subgroups, suggesting that the proposed model generalizes well across heterogeneous patient populations and care environments, supporting its potential utility in real-world deployment scenarios.

附录CAppendix C单预测方法的补充分析Supplementary analyses for the single-predictor approach

C.1 预测器提取器识别预测器（剩余预测器）Predictor recognition by the predictor extractor (remaining predictors)

表中报告了预测器提取器对其余 61 个预测器的分类性能The classification performance of the predictor extractor for the remaining 61 predictors is reported in TableLABEL:tab:results_single_predictor-2。在 71 个预测变量中，AUROC 值范围从 73.8% 到 100%，其中 58 个超过 90%，表明始终具有很强的判别能力。 AUPRC 和 F1 分数差异很大（0.3%-97.6% 和 0.0%-94.1%），很大程度上是由于类别不平衡造成的。例如，INJIL 类别仅包括 PTB-XL 测试集中的两个阳性病例（患病率 <0.1%），导致精确召回估计不稳定（测试 F1 = 0.0%；验证 F1 = 8.7%），尽管 AUROC 高达 92.9%。. Across the 71 predictors, AUROC values ranged from 73.8% to 100%, with 58 exceeding 90%, indicating consistently strong discriminative capacity. AUPRC and F1 scores varied substantially (0.3%-97.6% and 0.0%-94.1%), largely due to class imbalance. For instance, the INJIL category included only two positive cases in the PTB-XL test set (<0.1% prevalence), resulting in unstable precision-recall estimates (test F1 = 0.0%; validation F1 = 8.7%) despite a high AUROC of 92.9%.

设置决策阈值以最大化验证集上的 F1，确保所有预测变量均获得非零验证 F1 分数。由于下游 LEF 框架利用连续预测分数而不是依赖于阈值的二元决策，因此即使对于超稀有类别，强大的排名也足以可靠地传输信息。Decision thresholds were set to maximize F1 on the validation set, ensuring all predictors achieved non-zero validation F1 scores. Since the downstream LEF framework leverages continuous predictor scores rather than threshold-dependent binary decisions, robust ranking is sufficient to reliably transfer information even for ultra-rare categories.

C.2 单预测器性能（剩余预测器和外部结果）Single-predictor performance (remaining predictors and external results)

表中报告了 LEF 检测的其余单个预测器的性能The performance of the remaining single predictors for LEF detection is reported in TableLABEL:tab:results_single_predictor-2。表中提供了外部测试集性能. External test set performance is provided in TableLABEL:tab:results_single_predictor-2-ecgnote.

C.3 单预测器方法的阈值选择Threshold selection for the single-predictor approach

正在关注Following(Ribeiro et al., 2020)，我们采用 F1 分数作为主要性能指标，因为它对类别不平衡具有鲁棒性。 对于单预测方法，选择分类阈值以最大化验证集上的 F1 分数，与之前的研究一致, we adopt the F1 score as a primary performance metric due to its robustness to class imbalance. For the single-predictor method, the classification threshold is selected to maximize the F1 score on the validation set, consistent with prior studies(Ribeiro et al., 2020; Diao et al., 2025)。 作为替代操作点，我们还考虑基于召回率的阈值，强制执行最低召回率 90%。. As an alternative operating point, we also consider a recall-based threshold that enforces a minimum recall of 90%.

值得注意的是，在两种阈值策略下，单预测器方法用于检测 LEF 的阈值大大低于传统自动心电图诊断模型中采用的相应诊断阈值。大多数 AUROC 大于 0.60 的预测变量都观察到了这一趋势，如图所示Notably, under both thresholding strategies, the thresholds used by the single-predictor method for detecting LEF are substantially lower than the corresponding diagnosis thresholds employed in traditional automatic ECG diagnosis models. This trend is observed for most predictors with AUROC greater than 0.60, as summarized in FigureC.1.
